newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX WARM UP WELL FOR JUVENTUS MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX WARM UP WELL FOR JUVENTUS MATCH.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam had the best possible preparation for Wednesday's European Cup semi-final second leg against Juventus when they whipped NEC Nijmegen 5-0 in the Dutch first division on Friday.
It was a better dress rehearsal than coach Louis van Gaal could have hoped for after Ajax's 2-1 loss to Juventus last week and a 2-0 defeat by PSV last Sunday.
Although Winston Bogarde and Tijjani Babangida left the pitch injured, van Gaal was surprisingly happy. "It was a fabulous result with superb goals," he said.
Bogarde, who hurt his ankle just before half-time, opened the scoring after just 35 seconds when he headed home a Ronald de Boer cross.
Twenty minutes later Dani took advantage of a defensive error to make it 2-0.
In the 41st minute Bogarde scored his second, leaving the NEC defenders helpless after a 40-metre pass from Frank de Boer.
In the second half Ronald de Boer shot home from close range and Kiki Musampa made it 5-0 in the 68th minute.
In the 60th minute Ronald de Boer was replaced by Peter Hoekstra, who made his comeback after sustaining a bad knee injury last September.
Despite the victory Ajax remained in fourth spot overall, trailing league leaders PSV Eindhoven by 11 points with six matches to go.
